name: Kalvaert Removal Fee
brief: Adds the Belgian removal fee (verwijderingsbijdrage) as a managed line under electrical items on sales documents.
description: Per-tenant extension for the fictional Kalvaert case (UC-VK-10). An item carries a removal fee; on sales quotes, orders, invoices, credit memos and return orders for domestic customers a fee line is kept directly under the item line: quantity follows the item line, the line disappears with the item line or when the customer is not domestic, and users cannot edit it by hand.
